Supreme Court Declines to Intervene in Surrogate Mother Custody Case

The U.S. Supreme Court has declined to intervene in a custody dispute involving a surrogate mother and a California couple. The case centers on a surrogate mother who refused an abortion. The Supreme Court's decision means it will not hear the case, leaving lower court rulings in place.
